title.narrative: Shandong Spring City Green Modern Trolley Bus Demonstration Project

description.narrative:
The proposed project aims to improve the urban transport environment in Jinan, Shandong province by reducing emissions and congestion in the city through the development of a modern trolley bus network. It will be developed and designed through a project preparatory technical assistance (PPTA) in order to verify the technical, financial, economic, social and environmental viability of the project and develop sustainable urban mobility strategies for the city, to be implemented together with the trolley bus system. The outcome of the project will be enhanced sustainable urban mobility with integrated public transport services and a zero emission trolleybus network.
The PPTA will (i) prepare technical preliminary design of trolley bus infrastructure, trolley bus standard recommendation, trolley bus lane and stations, and trolley bus depots; (ii) conduct cost and benefit analysis, and financial analysis of the trolley bus system development and operation based on travel demand forecast; (iii) conduct a financial management assessment of the EA and IA; (iv) conduct safeguards assessments; (v) conduct emission reduction and impact analysis on health; and (vi) conduct sustainable urban mobility assessment and strategy preparation. The project will adopt a model-based approach for travel demand forecast, emission estimations, environment impact estimations and benefit estimations.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3583: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Jun 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: As of the October 2024, the cumulative contract awards have reached a total of 149.9 million (99.99% of loan amount), with corresponding disbursements totaling $150 million (100% of loan amount, including advance account).
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Aug 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50010/50010-002-apfs-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Sep 2017: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50010/50010-002-iee-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Sep 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50010/50010-002-sddr-en_0.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Overall, the project achieved about 99% physical progress.
Under Output 1: Zero-emission bus rapid transit network constructed. A network of 70.1 kilometers (km) of bus rapid transit lanes, served by electric trolley buses, has been established (60.8 km) or upgraded (14.3 km).
Under Output 2: Modern trolley bus and service standards implemented. A total of 350 electric trolley buses are currently in operation, having been successfully procured. Furthermore, 830 battery electric buses have been acquired and are actively serving the current transportation system, including 130 6-meter buses which provided connections from communities to bus stations.
Under Output 3: Travel demand management measures (TDM) for Jinan prepared. In January 2021, a consulting firm was enlisted to undertake a comprehensive policy study on travel demand measures.
